verdict.rationale: Unity's docs confirm a Unity Editor with an inspector and Editor Windows that can be extended with custom inspectors and Property Drawers, and they refer to authoring scenes. That makes a visual editor a documented first-party capability. However, the pack never directly documents the scene viewport, prefabs, or scene composition as the primary level-building workflow. missing for 10: documentation of the scene view/viewport, prefab system, scene composition/level-building workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a technical artist, a full visual editor — viewport, inspector, prefabs/scene composition — is the primary way to build levels

citations.quote: Unity lets you extend the editor with your own custom inspectors and Editor Windows and you can define how properties are displayed in the inspector with custom Property Drawers
Elevate your scenes with scalable, captivating visuals using the latest advances in rendering, lighting, and visual effects.
Unity can build your application for different platforms with unique build configurations using build profiles in the Unity Editor.
